name: mcp-identity-proxy-for-aws
description: A client-side MCP proxy that injects OAuth 2.0 bearer tokens or API keys into MCP requests, enabling MCP clients to connect to OAuth/API-key-protected MCP servers like Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway. It automatically fetches and refreshes credentials using AgentCore Identity or static values.
